theory.intro: Three benchmark percentages have quick mental shortcuts because they are simple fractions.
steps: Match the percentage to its fraction ($50\% = \tfrac12$, $25\% = \tfrac14$, $10\% = \tfrac{1}{10}$).
Combine benchmarks for other percentages if needed.

foundation.question_text: A collection has $250$ beads. Find $10\%$ of the collection.
A recipe uses $800$ grams of flour. Find $25\%$ of this mass.
A rope is $18$ metres long. Find $50\%$ of its length.
Find $25\%$ of a collection of $84$ cards.
A soup recipe makes $3.6$ litres. Find $50\%$ of the volume.
A ribbon is $4.5$ metres long. Find $10\%$ of its length.

development.question_text: A recipe makes $260$ millilitres of sauce. Find $25\%$ of the volume using a benchmark fraction.
A collection contains $126$ shells. How many shells are $50\%$ of the collection?
A path is $37$ metres long. What length is $10\%$ of the path?
A recipe uses $1.2$ kilograms of fruit. Find $25\%$ of this mass.
A $24$ metre roll is cut so that one piece is $50\%$ of the roll and another is $25\%$ of the roll. Find the length of each piece.
A collection has $320$ stamps. Find both $10\%$ and $25\%$ of the collection.

mastery.question_text: Which is greater: $25\%$ of a $360$-piece collection or $50\%$ of a $140$-piece collection? By how many pieces?
mastery.solution_text:
$25\%\text{ of }360=360\div4=90$
$50\%\text{ of }140=140\div2=70$
$90-70$
$=20$
$25\%$ of the $360$-piece collection is greater by $20$ pieces.

mastery.question_text: A $48$ metre cable has $50\%$ used for one section and $25\%$ used for another. How many metres of cable remain?
A recipe uses $640$ grams of mixture. One bowl receives $25\%$ and another receives $10\%$ of the mixture. What total mass is placed in the two bowls?
